reason: The README describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is monitoring session token usage and displaying estimated costs with dynamically fetched pricing, so notifications-monitoring is the best fit.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中显示当前会话的累计 token 用量和估算费用，并从 DeepSeek 官方价格页获取计价信息。
summaries.en: Displays cumulative session token usage and estimated costs in the DSH web interface using pricing data fetched from DeepSeek’s official pricing page.

capabilities: Reads cumulative session token usage from the DSH projection
Displays locally calculated token counts and estimated costs in the web interface
Fetches pricing data from the official DeepSeek pricing page
Provides host-side pricing and model lookup routes
